candidates: Thumbnailer function environment configuration (OUTPUT_BUCKET points to a non-existent S3 bucket)
Infrastructure template (IaC) definition of the Thumbnailer OUTPUT_BUCKET value
answer.explanation: Starting at 00:21:39.958Z, the Thumbnailer function fails every invocation with NoSuchBucket on S3 PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET; there are 400 such errors in the window and none before it. No other function shows errors in the window. NoSuchBucket (not AccessDenied) rules out IAM and points to the bucket name the function resolves at runtime, so the live OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable is the most likely fault, with the IaC template as the source if it was deployed from there. Limitation: I had no tool to read the function configuration, IAM policies, CloudTrail or the IaC history, so the CONFIG layer and the exact artifact are inferred from the log evidence rather than confirmed.
